blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: It's a privilege, not a right.
exercises.ru: Это привилегия, ___ не право.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Cats eat mice, but our cat Mr Peterson is friends with one.
exercises.ru: Коты едят мышей, ___ наш кот, мистер Питерсон, с одной подружился.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom isn't a Kurd, but he speaks fluent Kurdish.
exercises.ru: Том не курд, ___ свободно говорит по-курдски.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: My name's Ricardo, and you?
exercises.ru: Меня зовут Рикардо, ___ тебя?
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom peeled the potatoes and then boiled them.
exercises.ru: Том почистил картошку, ___ затем отварил её.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: That sounds like our tugboat horn.
exercises.ru: ___ это похоже на гудок буксира.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Old broom knows every corner of a room, but the new cleans better.
exercises.ru: Старая метла каждый угол знает, ___ новая чище метёт.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: In poker, what's a full house?
exercises.ru: ___ что такое «фулл-хаус» в покере?
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The mice kept nibbling at the cactus, no matter how much it pricked them and made them cry.
exercises.ru: Мыши плакали, кололись, ___ продолжали грызть кактус.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Truth enlightens the mind, but won't always bring happiness to your heart.
exercises.ru: Истина просвещает разум, ___ не всегда приносит счастье вашему сердцу.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Siberians do not surrender to their captors, but they are not taken captive anyway.
exercises.ru: Сибиряки в плен не сдаются, ___ и в плен не берут.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: But now, when only one step was left to reach the goal, Orestes suddenly lost his courage.
exercises.ru: ___ теперь, когда до цели остался лишь шаг, Орест внезапно растерялся.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Water gurgles while fire crackles.
exercises.ru: Вода булькает, ___ огонь трещит.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: My dog is an Alaskan malamute, not a husky.
exercises.ru: Моя собака - аляскинский маламут, ___ не эскимосская лайка.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: He is a good fellow, to be sure, but he isn't reliable.
exercises.ru: Он, конечно, хороший парень, ___ не отличается надёжностью.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I don't mean to be antisocial, but I'm tired.
exercises.ru: Я не хочу быть антиобщественным, ___ я устал.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: He's not even 30 and he has a receding hairline.
exercises.ru: Ему ещё нет тридцати, ___ волосы уже редеют.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Can't you calculate this?
exercises.ru: ___ посчитать это нельзя?
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: But your function isn't Lipschitz continuous!
exercises.ru: ___ твоя функция не липшицевая!
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The fire was quickly contained and then extinguished.
exercises.ru: Пожар был быстро локализован, ___ затем потушен.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
